title: My Framework Investment Should NOT Have Worked Out
summary: Linus Tech Tips covers Framework's newly announced devices, including its first desktop, with comments from Framework's CEO about the company's design decisions.
why: Used as a source for the Framework CEO's explanation of why the desktop's memory could not be socketed or modular.

quote.text: This sort-of-interview of Nirav Patel (ceo of framework) explains in a bit more detail
